name: mashumaro-pagerules
instr:
Paging rules reverted after pagerd restart

pagerd got restarted in Tuesday's maintenance window and since then some rules page like they did before people tuned them last week. payments-api-latency is re-paging every 15 minutes again, and a couple of others page for stuff their teams had filtered out. Nobody touched them after the edits, which worked fine until the restart. The store is just the mashumaro dataclass from paging_rules.py dumped to rules.json. That file as written at shutdown, the model and the service log are in /workdir/evidence; I can't share the rest of pagerd.

The checkout is in /workdir. Could you track down where this actually goes wrong and fix it
there? Please include a regression test, somewhere under tests/ (say tests/test_repro.py), that fails on the current code because
of this problem (a failing assertion, not an import error) and passes once it's fixed.
Test the reported behaviour, not your patch: it should still pass if the bug gets fixed some other correct
way, so no asserting on source text or on helpers only your fix has. It should run on its own
from a clean checkout with just your test files added. Keep it under a minute.

I doubt I'm the only one hitting this. Anything else that goes through that code is probably
wrong too, so please fix it at the source rather than special-casing my input. The fix belongs in
the library itself, not in the tests. CI runs the full test suite on every change,
so it shouldn't break anything else.

When you'r
